metadata.question: Between January 29 and February 5, 2019, was there at least a 30 degree Celcius difference in the highest daily air temperature at 2 meters in Boston, MA?

data.raw_code: 1. Search strategy: - Need ERA5-Land Daily Aggregated dataset for air temperature at 2m - Location: Boston, MA (approximately 42.36°N, 71.06°W) - Date range: January 29 to February 5, 2019 - Need to find the maximum daily temperature for each day, then compare highest vs lowest 2. Masking strategy: - No cloud masking needed for ERA5-Land (reanalysis data) - Need to extract temperature values for each day 3. Logic to distinguish: - Valid Zero: If temperature difference exists and is < 30°C → B - Valid Result: If temperature difference ≥ 30°C → A - C1: If no images found in collection - C2: Not applicable (ERA5 is continuous) - C3: If temperature values are None/NaN or unrealistic (e.g., >100°C or <-100°C) - D: Syntax/method errors 4. Approach: - Get daily maximum temperature (temperature_2m is in Kelvin, convert to Celsius) - Find the highest max temp and lowest max temp across the period - Calculate difference ```javascript const ee = require('@google/earthengine'); const privateKey = require('../auth_keys/test-project-473922-29f05d49bed7'); async function runAnalysis() { // 1. Define geometry for Boston, MA const boston = ee.Geometry.Point([-71.06, 42.36]); // 2. Define date range const startDate = '2019-01-29'; const endDate = '2019-02-06'; // Inclusive of Feb 5 // 3. Load ERA5-Land Daily Aggregated data const era5 = ee.ImageCollection('ECMWF/ERA5_LAND/DAILY_AGGR') .filterDate(startDate, endDate) .filterBounds(boston) .select('temperature_2m_max'); // Maximum daily temperature at 2m // 4. Check collection size const collectionSize = era5.size().getInfo(); console.log(`Collection size: ${collectionSize} images`); if (collectionSize === 0) { console.log("No data found for the specified period."); console.log("C1"); return; } // 5. Extract temperature values for each day const imageList = era5.toList(collectionSize); let temperatures = []; let validCount = 0; for (let i = 0; i < collectionSize; i++) { const image = ee.Image(imageList.get(i)); const date = ee.Date(image.get('system:time_start')).format('YYYY-MM-dd').getInfo(); const stats = image.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.mean(), geometry: boston, scale: 11132, maxPixels: 1e9 }); const tempKelvin = stats.get('temperature_2m_max').getInfo(); if (tempKelvin !== null && tempKelvin !== undefined) { const tempCelsius = tempKelvin - 273.15; temperatures.push(tempCelsius); console.log(`${date}: ${tempCelsius.toFixed(2)}°C`); validCount++; } } // 6. Check if we have valid data if (validCount === 0) { console.log("No valid temperature values retrieved."); console.log("C3"); return; } // 7. Find max and min temperatures const maxTemp = Math.max(...temperatures); const minTemp = Math.min(...temperatures); const difference = maxTemp - minTemp; console.log(`\nHighest daily max temp: ${maxTemp.toFixed(2)}°C`); console.log(`Lowest daily max temp: ${minTemp.toFixed(2)}°C`); console.log(`Temperature difference: ${difference.toFixed(2)}°C`); // 8. Validate temperatures are realistic if (maxTemp > 60 || minTemp < -60) { console.log("Temperature values outside realistic range."); console.log("C3"); return; } // 9. Final answer if (difference >= 30) { console.log("A"); } else { console.log("B"); } } async function initEE() { await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.data.authenticateViaPrivateKey(privateKey, resolve, reject); }); await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.initialize(null, null, resolve, reject); }); await runAnalysis(); } initEE(); ```
